comment: Read by scripts/db-shards.ts, which splits the database conformance run items across the CI shards.

parts: a suite too long for one shard runs as k items, <path>#i/k, each with SUITE_PART=i/k; the suite registers only the cases inPart gives its part. d06-generated took 5721s across its six parts (median, below), 12 to 18 minutes a part, so it runs in 18; d06-agent took 591s whole, so it runs in 2.

seconds: each run item's time in a hosted shard, the median over the green merge groups of 19 October 2026 (runs 39187815599, 39187815006, 39187101958, 39186908423, 39186909362; the 'moved the database counter by N in Ss' lines), every one of the 1630 items then named, the parts of a split suite each timed as run. Only the balance reads them: an item missing here still runs, weighted at the median. Refresh from a recent run when the shards drift apart.
